name: Counselor-in-Training (CIT) Program
what_you_do: Help lead summer day camp activities and assist counselors and campers, set personal goals and meet weekly with other CITs.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 15 who have completed 7th grade.
pay_detail: No wage is listed on the page; it is described as training for future summer and part-time jobs. Confirm with the contact.
duration: 15 to 20 hours a week, three days a week, June 3 to July 31 in 2026 (8:15 am to 3 pm)
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due March 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the CIT application (PDF or online form on the Teen Programs page). Questions: Cathy Schneider (contact link on the page).
notes: Because pay is not stated, ask whether CITs are paid before applying. Illinois requires an employment certificate under age 16 (see the Illinois rules on this site).
